summary: US strikes in Iran killed three Iranian Army pilots, prompting Iranian warnings of a new strategy and threats of forceful retaliation if Israel targets the Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon where IRGC personnel are reportedly present. Meanwhile, IDF forces eliminated a terrorist in northern Gaza and demolished a kilometer-long tunnel, while clashes erupted during a livestock retrieval operation in the West Bank.
key_points: US strikes killed three Iranian pilots: Mojtaba Baqeri, Hamed Okati, and Hossein Mehdiouyan. (Source: @kianmeli1/91482)
Iran warns US it will respond forcefully if Israel attacks Ali Taher ridge complex in south Lebanon housing at least 12 IRGC personnel including two senior officers. (Source: @asafroz/53038)
IDF eliminated a terrorist who crossed the yellow line in northern Gaza, posing immediate threat. (Source: @almogboker78/18120)
IDF combat engineers demolished a kilometer-long tunnel in northern Gaza; over 26 km of tunnels destroyed since October 2025 ceasefire. (Source: @shin_persian/9419)

Israeli forces secured entry to Al-Mughayyir village to retrieve livestock; violent riots ensued with Palestinians throwing blocks and stones, IDF fired at main instigators. (Source: @idf_telegram/25036)
Iran's Mohsen Rezaei threatens "new strategy" in war, diplomacy, and economic siege that will break US foundations. (Source: @VahidOnline/78192)
Trump claims at least 65,000 protesters killed in Iran; suggests renaming Strait of Hormuz to Strait of Trump. (Source: @New_security8200/203581)
Kuwait includes Iranian attacks on US bases in school curriculum as Iranian aggressions against Kuwait. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89290)

sections.executive_summary: US strikes in Iran killed three Iranian Army pilots, prompting Iranian warnings of a new strategy and threats of forceful retaliation if Israel targets the Ali Taher ridge in southern Lebanon where IRGC personnel are reportedly present. Meanwhile, IDF forces eliminated a terrorist in northern Gaza and demolished a kilometer-long tunnel, while clashes erupted during a livestock retrieval operation in the West Bank.

points: US strikes killed three Iranian Army pilots: Mojtaba Baqeri and Hamed Okati (Naval Aviation) and Hossein Mehdiouyan (Air Force), per Iranian state media and official announcements. (Source: @kianmeli1/91482, @SharghDaily/181663)

Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, warned the US that Tehran will employ a "new strategy" in warfare, diplomacy, and countering economic siege that will break US foundations. (Source: @VahidOnline/78192)

Iranian MP Ismail Kowsari stated that since 1987, the "3rd Force" has planned to close the Strait of Hormuz, criticizing concentration of 90% oil exports at Kharg Island. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80251)

Former President Rouhani declared Iran will not submit to Trump's plot, emphasizing Strait of Hormuz must remain vibrant as a security lever, and called for national unity behind armed forces. (Source: @SharghDaily/181654)
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent vowed to sever every Iranian tie to the outside world, describing an "all hands on deck" approach. (Source: @shin_persian/9416)
IRGC militant Mahdi Bohrani, killed on Lavan Island, was 17 years old, per IRGC-affiliated Tasnim News. (Source: @shin_persian/9427)
Trump claimed at least 65,000 protesters have been killed in Iran. (Source: @New_security8200/203581)

IDF eliminated a terrorist in northern Gaza who crossed the yellow line and approached forces, constituting an immediate threat; forces remain deployed per ceasefire agreement. (Source: @almogboker78/18120)

Combat engineers of the Yahalom unit and Gaza Division Northern Brigade demolished a kilometer-long tunnel in northern Gaza; over 26 kilometers of tunnels destroyed on Israeli side of ceasefire line since October 2025 ceasefire. (Source: @shin_persian/9419)
Division 210 completed a Golan Heights exercise simulating dozens of scenarios to enhance operational readiness for emergent events. (Source: @idf_telegram/25037)
A UH-60 Black Hawk transport helicopter was spotted heading toward northern occupied Palestine. (Source: @redlinkleb/40414)

Israeli Channel 15 reported a 30-year-old soldier in the tracking and monitoring unit planned to join ISIS, researching drone and explosives manufacturing for terrorist purposes. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388553)
